blurb: Betty Jean's Dance Studio offers a variety of dance classes including ballet, tap, hip hop, jazz, lyrical/contemporary, musical theater, and classes for very young children such as Baby Bop and Toddler Time. They also host birthday parties with dance instruction and snacks. The studio has a boutique selling dance shoes, outfits, and stuffed animals.
